Performance

Where the milliseconds go in detect_circles, measured per image rather than claimed in aggregate. The five-radius FRST voting pass dominates; the gradient is computed once and reused by scoring and refinement, so those stages stay cheap even when proposals are plentiful.

Per-image stage breakdown

Per-stage p50 of the detect_circles pipeline, decomposed exactly as run_detection runs it: gradient (Sobel, once) → voting (FRST, once) → extract (NMS proposals) → score (every proposal) → refine (accepted proposals only). Each bar is normalised to its image's total; absolute per-stage milliseconds are listed beneath it.
